# --- A bundle in the Trash, which is never an installation -----------------

#
# --- Casks with no application, which the cask rules must still resolve ----
# Uninstalling an application by dragging it to the Trash leaves Homebrew's
# own symlink behind, pointing at nothing. A line with "->" is a symlink, and
# these two dangle exactly as they do on the reference machine.
opt/homebrew/Caskroom/cursor/1.2.4
opt/homebrew/Caskroom/cursor/1.2.4/Cursor.app -> /Applications/Cursor.app
opt/homebrew/Caskroom/stremioservice/0.1.15
opt/homebrew/Caskroom/stremioservice/0.1.15/StremioService.app -> /Applications/StremioService.app
opt/homebrew/Caskroom/devtoys/2.0.6
opt/homebrew/Caskroom/devtoys/2.0.6/DevToys.app -> /Applications/DevToys.app
opt/homebrew/Caskroom/mattermost/5.12.1
opt/homebrew/Caskroom/mattermost/5.12.1/Mattermost.app -> /Applications/Mattermost.app
